content: If the configuration parameter DemOccurrenceCounterPro- cessing is set to DEM_PROCESS_OCCCTR_TF (refer to DemPrimaryMemory or De- mUserDefinedMemory ), the Dem module shall increment the occurrence counter by one, triggered by each UDS status bit 0 (TestFailed) transition from 0 to 1, if the related event is already stored in the event memory .
